english.note: Use this especially for a physical object, machine, or system that is broken or not working.
Use this especially when the damaged object is faulty or no longer working, such as a machine.
Use 壞 as the all-purpose choice when a system or machine is not functioning; for an aircraft, it covers mechanical failure only.
Use this for a damaged or invalid file, text, or other digital or technical item, often said as 壞咗.
Use 壞 when something is not working or is out of order.

examples.english: The photocopier is faulty and cannot print documents.
examples.traditional: 部影印機壞咗，印唔到文件。

examples.english: Something is wrong with the air conditioner.

english.note: Use 壞 for something intrinsically harmful, evil, broken, spoiled, fake, or for a child who is being naughty.

examples.english: Smoking has a bad effect on your health.
